name: Do I need to be home during the roof replacement process?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be home during the roof replacement process?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's not strictly necessary for you to be home for the entire duration of the roof replacement, we recommend being available for the initial consultation and final walkthrough. This allows us to discuss project details, address any questions, and ensure your satisfaction with the completed work. During the construction phase, our team handles all aspects, but clear communication channels will be maintained for updates or immediate concerns.
acceptedAnswer.description: You don't need to be home for the entire process, but we suggest being present for the initial consultation and final walkthrough.
